description: Defines the FrontPanelTextDisplay class and its nested classes for managing front panel text display, scrolling, brightness, and modes in a device settings context.

classes.name: FrontPanelTextDisplay
classes.description: Manages front panel text display, scrolling, brightness, and modes.

classes.name: FrontPanelTextDisplay::Mode
classes.description: Extends DSConstant to manage display modes like clock or string display.

classes.name: FrontPanelTextDisplay::Scroll
classes.description: Handles scrolling parameters such as vertical/horizontal iterations and hold duration.

methods.name: FrontPanelTextDisplay::Scroll::Scroll
methods.description: Constructor initializing scroll parameters with default or specified values.

methods.name: FrontPanelTextDisplay::getCurrentTimeFormat
methods.description: Retrieves current time format setting (12hr or 24hr).

methods.name: FrontPanelTextDisplay::setMode
methods.description: Sets display mode: text, clock, or both.
